name: Motion Creative Analytics
description: Motion connects Claude to your meta ad data. Analyze creative performance across campaigns — surface top performers, spot declining creatives, and understand what's working and why. Research competitor ad libraries for trends and inspiration. Access demographic breakdowns, creative transcripts, and performance reports. Motion helps marketers make faster, data-driven decisions about what to create next.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Motion Creative Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Motion Creative Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://projects.motionapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Motion Creative Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Motion Creative Analytics lists 14 MCP tools, including get_auth_context, get_creative_insights, get_demographic_breakdown, get_workspace_brand, get_workspace_competitors, search_brands, get_brand_by_domain, get_inspo_brand_context, get_inspo_creatives, get_creative_summary, get_creative_transcript, and get_glossary_values.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Motion Creative Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Motion Creative Analytics in data on the Manufact MCP catalog include Aura, Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks, Enterpret, Nimble, and Origin.

_published_faq.name: Does Motion Creative Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Motion Creative Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Motion Creative Analytics is developed by Motion Creative Analytics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
